tiers.name: existing_model_direct_predict
tiers.description: Frozen FCMAE backbone + current 2-seed projection-head ensemble, zero-shot. Lowest-risk operating point.

tiers.name: current_best_recipe_retrain
tiers.description: Champion recipe retrain via the real recovered trainer (_may_ablation.py cell B4 -> _may_repro_src.py), REPRO_SEED 1/2/42, label-free epoch pick. Rewired 260726 off train_contrastive_ddp.py (no real --seed there).

steps.name: train_frozen_recipe

recipe.lr_head_note: 4e-3 supersedes the original plan's 1e-3 per team-lead 260726 (measured: lock-in noise 31.0->23.2%, fragmentation also improved)
recipe.backbone_note: not overridden -- uses _may_repro_src.py's own default LOCAL_BACKBONE_WEIGHTS (_b4_backbone.pth, the real recovered b4 backbone), which is what makes this 'the champion recipe'

steps.env_note: REPRO_IGNORE_NEG_SIM (not REPRO_NEG) per team-lead 260726 -- REPRO_NEG is read by _may_repro_src.py at import time but then overwritten by _may_ablation.py's B4 cell hardcode (IGNORE_NEG_SIM=0.72, same value here so it wouldn't currently show a bug, but REPRO_IGNORE_NEG_SIM is the one _may_ablation.py re-applies after the cell merge and is therefore the only one that is guaranteed correct if the B4 cell definition ever changes).
steps.resolve_output_note: _may_ablation.py builds its own runs/may_repro/abl{REPRO_TAG}_B4_<RUN_TS>/ dir internally (no --out flag). scripts/run_unknown_campaign.py::resolve_trainer_output_dir globs for it by REPRO_TAG among dirs created after this step started, 0 or 2+ matches -> hard failure (260726 team-lead fix, replaces the earlier unresolved-path gap).

steps.name: select_epoch_label_free
steps.description: Wire to scripts/label_free_gate.py once (a) the tier-2 training step's actual output dir is resolved (see the top-level 'notes' gap on _may_ablation.py's internal RUN_TS-suffixed path) and (b) per-epoch embeddings are exported from its proj_ep*.pt checkpoints. Placeholder command.

tiers.name: recipe_and_grouping_sweep
tiers.description: 1-seed/4-epoch pilot (10 cells) -> top4 full 20ep -> top2 3-seed. HDBSCAN dial grid on cached embeddings (validation only, no re-training). Temporal threshold sweep. Wafer 4-dataset shortlist then HF 3-dataset transfer check.
tiers.selection_note: The runner does not auto-rank pilot cells -- inspect runs/campaign_registry.jsonl for the 10 pilot records (tier=3, step name matches a pilot_cells[].name), pick the top 4 by the label-free gate (coherence/bootstrap-stability/noise/fragmentation, scripts/label_free_gate.py), add 4 explicit tier-3 steps at 20 epochs, then top 2 at 3 seeds. This keeps an untested auto-selection heuristic out of an unmanned multi-day loop.

cluster_sweep_grid.note: Validation-only, operates on already-embedded pools (no re-training) via grouping_deploy.py --mcs/--ms/--eps/--reassign/--method. Not auto-expanded into concrete steps yet -- do that once a tier-2 or tier-3 champion embedding exists to sweep over.

wafer_shortlist_then_hf_transfer.note: Pick 4 wafer datasets from the tier-3 result, then confirm the same recipe/dial transfers to hf_dtd/hf_flowers102/hf_resisc45 before promotion consideration.

tiers.name: cnn_tapt_then_sweep
tiers.description: known-cnn TAPT backbone init, same tier-3 sweep. Only promoted if it beats the frozen champion -- never demotes an already-set lower-tier champion regardless of its own gate result.
tiers.backbone_init_note: classified as type=cnn-tapt by scripts/campaign_checkpoint.py -- valid ONLY as a --backbone-init source (e.g. via _may_repro_src.py's LOCAL_BACKBONE_WEIGHTS / REPRO_BACKBONE, extracting backbone-only weights first), never as a grouping-predictor checkpoint. If retraining known-cnn itself is needed first, novel classes must stay excluded (known-train classes only).
